name: CAP Sleep Database: Cyclic Alternating Pattern Polysomnographic Benchmark
description: The CAP Sleep Database is a collection of 108 polysomnographic (PSG) sleep recordings compiled by the Sleep Disorders Center of the Ospedale Maggiore of Parma, Italy, and hosted on PhysioNet. Cyclic Alternating Pattern (CAP) is a periodic EEG activity pattern occurring during non-REM sleep that reflects sleep instability, micro-arousals, and autonomic fluctuations. The database includes overnight polysomnograms from 16 healthy control subjects and 92 patients diagnosed with sleep disorders (including nocturnal frontal lobe epilepsy, sleep apnea, narcolepsy, REM behavior disorder, and periodic leg movements). Records include multi-channel electroencephalogram (EEG), electrooculogram (EOG), electromyogram (EMG), and respiratory channels annotated by expert sleep physicians according to standard Rechtschaffen & Kales sleep stages and CAP phases (A-phase subtypes A1, A2, A3, and B-phase intervals).
